attribution: Traced from the Plan of the Yuanmingyuan, Princeton University Art Museum 2022-27 a-c (S01). Image courtesy of the Princeton University Art Museum. Grades from the Forty Scenes album (BnF) and the sources cited per feature; C lines are guesses, marked assumed.
